attributes.board_name: Louisiana State Board of Social Work Examiners (LABSWE)

rules.accepted_credit_types: In-person offerings and synchronous webinars sponsored/approved by social work licensing bodies, board-authorized pre-approval organizations, state/national social work organizations, CSWE-accredited schools; ASWB-approved providers; other activities per LAC 46:XXV §1305 (non-preapproved training needs the Guide for Assessment of CE)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Pro-rated in the initial year: credential received Jun-Aug 0 h; Sep-Nov 20 h; Dec-Feb 15 h; Mar-May 10 h.
rules.carryover: Up to 10 surplus hours may carry over (not ethics hours or BACS supervision hours).
rules.audit_note: Random audits; keep CE records at least 1 year. Proof of completion must be submitted to the Board by the end of the renewal period.

topics.who: Ethics hours on a 2-year collection period ending in even-numbered years (hour count not stated on the board CE page)
Social workers providing or receiving telesupervision (effective Oct 20, 2025), one-time
Board-approved clinical supervisors (BACS): clinical supervision training hours, 2-year period ending in even years

rules.notes: CE collection period Sept 1 - Aug 31; renewal by Aug 31 each year. LCSWs: 10 of 20 hours clinical (diagnosis and treatment). Max 10 hours asynchronous; synchronous interactive webinars count as in-person. Hour = 60 minutes.
